name: hx1-r4-three-way-mark-middle
description: Sol HX1 r4 R4-3: A1..A3 connected, B1..B3 and C1..C3 headers off G, reload: three equal-work loaded tips with sequence id 0, so the reload's m_best_header pick is an address tie; up and down pick the extremes, a seeded heap may pick B3, the middle, and mark-conflicting B3 then moves m_best_header to B2. Each seed must give one vector in every process.
